title: How to convert images?
subtitle: HEIC to JPG conversion is a simple process that can be done in just a few steps. Here's how to do it:

steps.name: Upload HEIC file
steps.description: Upload your HEIC file to our website. It's free and takes just a few seconds.

steps.name: Convert HEIC to JPG
steps.description: Once the upload is complete, the conversion process will begin automatically. This will transform your HEIC file into JPG format.

steps.name: Download JPG file
steps.description: Once the conversion is complete, you can download your JPG file. It's that easy!
